title: Quality, but HUGE.......
text: Quality, but HUGE........ I returned this "mixing bowl".....the quality was fine and it was my fault because I did not realize how HUGE this would be.  It is so big that you could bathe in it.....  I would recommend this HUGE "bowl" if you are mixing for 30 or 40 people.  As I stated the "bowl" seems to be quality, just be sure you need that size, which is huge.

product_metadata.title: Update International (MB-400) 4 qt Stainless Steel Mixing Bowl
features: Can be used for wet or dry ingredients
description: This mixing bowl is a staple in both commercial and home kitchens, and is commonly used for mixing sauces, marinades, salad dressings, and more. The wide and shallow design ensures even mixing of wet or dry ingredients, and the slight lip is enough to make the bowl easy to grip when stirring. It is made of stainless steel with a mirror finish and is dishwasher safe. The capacity of this bowl is 4 Qt and it measures 0.4mm in thickness
